data.narrative:
Periodic Labs is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Liam Fedus and Ekin Dogus Cubuk, with $300M raised to date. The relevant comp universe comprises 9 private peers (including Palantir, Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI) and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) in the AI & Software sector.

A single valuation method is applicable here. Stage-Progression analysis uses the company's $300M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in this sector, yielding an implied valuation of $750M. Peer-Median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-set peers; while 16 same-sector companies exist, fewer than 3 meet filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier, making sector-wide medians unreliably broad.

The single-method triangulation supports a range of $638M (low) to $862M (high), centered on a median of $750M. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for Periodic Labs' specific risk profile and the absence of closer peer data; a more refined valuation would benefit from additional comparable transactions or revenue/burn metrics for calibration.
